lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrCdSe₃ crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1 (No. 1), with a unit cell containing five atoms and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd centers in a tetrahedral environment coordinated by four Se atoms at distances of 2.5317–2.6118 Å, while Sr centers have nine geometric neighbors (four Se and five Sr) at 2.7617–3.3814 Å. The Cd tetrahedra share corners with each other and with Sr 9-vertex polyhedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
